<div class="card-body">
'''Nalan Cheel''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ネイラン・チール</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「ビス・シャッフル」を使用した直後に、シャッフルしたデッキの上からX枚を見ることができる。X＝同じ位置カード上にいるミュージシャンの人数である。カードを見る代わりに、再度シャッフルしてもよい。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Nalan-Cheel-PSA-164793241.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス男性のミュージシャン。フィグリン・ダンのバンドでの演奏を楽しんではいるが、ときどき生まれ育ったクラクドアVIIのピンクに泡立つ沼が恋しくなる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Nalan Cheel.

'''Card text:'''
Immediately after using Bith Shuffle, you may look at the top X cards of the shuffled deck. X = the number of musicians at the same location card. You may shuffle again instead of looking.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. He enjoys playing in Figrin D'an's band, but sometimes misses the bubbling pink swamps of Clak'dor VII where he grew up.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese X is musicians at the same location; English counts other musicians at the same site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Nalan Cheel]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
